hero.title: Import Export Code (IEC)
hero.description: IEC, which stands for Import Export Code, is a unique 10-digit ID code for businesses. The Director General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) issues this code. Companies that import or export goods and services from India need an IEC. This code helps smooth out international trade operations. Customs clearance and money transfers across borders also require an IEC.

overview.title: Service Overview
paragraphs: IEC serves as a primary identification number for international trade, enabling companies to clear shipments, transfer funds and avail various benefits from government schemes. It is mandatory for you to get an IEC if you are looking to start your import export business. Get reliable services from a globally trusted compliance company. At JR Compliance we value your aim to reach global markets.

groups.title: Eligibility
items: Business Entity: From sole proprietors to private limited companies, all can apply for an IEC without restrictions.
No Minimum Turnover Required: An IEC can be applied for irrespective of the size of your business or its revenue, which makes it a good option for start-ups.
Legal Entity Requirement: The applicant should be a registered legal entity and submit relevant documents like PAN and proof of address.
Application: Anyone who is an individual or organization can apply for the IEC.

groups.title: Documents
items: Business PAN Card: This is the key document that serves as the business’s tax identification for import-export transactions.
GST Registration Certificate: Required to ensure compliance with indirect tax regulations while engaging in international trade.
Address Proof of Business: Any utility bill, lease deed, or ownership proof showcasing the business's operational location.
Bank Certificate or Cancelled Cheque: Proof of an active business bank account to facilitate transactions.
Aadhaar or Passport of Applicant: Identity verification of the company’s owner or authorized signatory.

groups.title: Who Needs It
items: Businesses Involved in Imports/ Exports: Companies and individuals looking to participate in international trade must obtain an IEC to meet legal requirements.
E-Commerce Exporters: Online retailers sending products overseas must have an IEC to facilitate shipment clearance and tap into global markets.
Customs Clearance Seekers: Individuals or entities importing/exporting goods need IEC for seamless clearance through Indian customs authorities.
Service Exporters: Service providers offering expertise internationally must obtain an IEC to receive foreign payments without hurdles.

items.question: Is IEC compulsory for all the importers and exporters?
items.answer: Yes, IEC is compulsory for all the business owner who plan to initiate their import and export activities from India.

items.question: How many days does it take to get an IEC?
items.answer: The IEC takes up to 10 to 15 days after submitting the application to be verified then the code to be issued.

items.question: Does the IEC need renewal?
items.answer: No, once IEC issued it does not need renewals as it is a lifetime valid document for any business.

items.question: Can a person request an IEC?
items.answer: Yes, individuals who are proprietors of a business can get an IEC.

items.question: Whether there is a return filling requirement for IEC?
items.answer: No, IEC do not have to file the periodic returns with DGFT.
